review_finding: A search hit is not a capability or absence finding; matched technical sources and licensing/runtime remain to be checked.
successor_finding: TreatmentEffect describes IPW, RA, AIPW, AIPW-WLS and IPW-RA with joint-GMM inference.; effect_group distinguishes all, treated and untreated populations; the documented outcome model is linear OLS.; ps_bounds defaults to (0.001,0.999), validates 0<lower<upper<1 and is used to clip predicted selection probabilities.; The class notes state that final GMM inference corresponds to HC0 regardless of the internal _cov_type keyword; the early module comment about missing standard errors is not an adequate current contract.
successor_remaining: Trace exact GMM covariance and each estimator, inspect clipping impact and test population/parameter-label roundtrips. Full cell search and alternatives remain open.
dependency_finding: MEstimator solves stacked equations, differentiates their sum, scales bread and meat by the number of supplied contribution columns, and scales the sandwich once more for estimator variance. compute_meat forms the outer-product sum of supplied columns. It does not add lag products or infer borrower/calendar clusters from data labels. The default permits a pseudoinverse; solver convergence and a finite sandwich do not establish identification or weak-rank coverage. The GMM covariance path defaults to weights_method=cov, an outer-product covariance divided by n; HAC is a separate explicit path requiring maxlag and using a supplied kernel or Bartlett default. GMMResults obtains the covariance method from fit options and recomputes moment covariance. Preliminary outcome _cov_type settings in TreatmentEffect do not select this final path. The inspected covariance code centers with moms.mean() rather than a per-column mean; sensitivity to nonzero moment residuals remains a qualification question.
dependency_remaining: Compare derivatives against analytic small models, validate independently sampled group aggregation, and derive actual dependence correction before using on persistent calendars. Trace each estimator call and all options, validate analytic moments and time ordering, then compare covariance and rank diagnostics. Do not infer cluster support or calibration from a generic robust label.
